blurb: Prescott Golf Club offers an 18-hole fully irrigated golf course with excellent conditions from tee to green. The clubhouse overlooks the course and is suitable for banquets, corporate functions, weddings, and other celebrations. The club is located 40 minutes south of Ottawa, between Cornwall and Kingston, facing the St. Lawrence River.
highlights: 18 holes of golf on a fully irrigated, well maintained course
hoursText: Golf shop opens 30 minutes before the first tee time each morning and closes approximately 2 hours before sunset.
Office open 8:00am-2:00pm Monday-Friday during golf season, limited hours off season.
